options.name: 显示本月用量
options.note: 在「今日用量」中显示 Cursor 本月已用的额度和重置日期
options.noteEn: Show how much of this month's Cursor usage you've used, and when it resets, under Today's usage
options.optIn: Cursor 不在本机记录用量，也没有提供第三方查询接口。打开后，Kiteline 将读取 Cursor 保存在本机的登录凭证（编辑器数据目录中 state.vscdb 的 cursorAuth/accessToken 一项，只装了命令行时读其 auth.json），每 10 分钟向 Cursor 服务器查询一次本月用量和套餐，与 Cursor 设置页显示的一致。凭证仅在本机使用，不会上传，也不会发送到手机。此查询方式并非 Cursor 官方提供，Cursor 更新后可能失效。
options.optInEn: Cursor doesn't record usage on your computer and offers no third-party usage API. When turned on, Kiteline reads the sign-in token Cursor stores on this computer (cursorAuth/accessToken in the editor's state.vscdb, or the CLI's auth.json if only the CLI is installed) and asks Cursor's servers for this month's usage and plan every 10 minutes, the same figures shown in Cursor's settings. The token is used only on this computer; it is never uploaded or sent to your phone. This isn't an official Cursor interface and may stop working after a Cursor update.

limitsNote: 打开下方「显示本月用量」后，在「今日用量」中显示 Cursor 本月用量（按账单月）
limitsNoteEn: Turn on “Show monthly usage” below to see Cursor's usage for the current billing month under Today's usage
speaker: Cursor
notes: 新接入 Cursor：编辑器和命令行 agent 的对话都能在手机上查看（状态、完整记录、改动对比、任务清单），能从手机发消息、允许或拒绝命令、中断任务。编辑器里的对话空闲时，Kiteline 会把 Cursor 中这个项目的编辑器窗口切到前台发送，再切回原来的程序；命令行在 tmux 中运行时可直接回复和确认。Agents 窗口、远程工作区中的对话会说明原因和处理办法。
notesEn: Cursor support: view Cursor editor and CLI agent chats on your phone (status, full history, diffs, task lists), and send messages, allow or reject commands and stop tasks from your phone. For idle editor chats, Kiteline brings the Cursor editor window for that project to the front to send and then switches back; when the CLI runs in tmux you can reply and confirm directly. Chats in the Agents window or in remote workspaces explain the reason and what to do.
